Rh8# is checkmate because the king cannot move (f7 and h7 are blocked by its own pieces) and the rook cannot be captured or blocked. The key lesson: when your opponent's king is hemmed in by its own pieces on the back rank, look for forcing queen sacrifices that push the king into the corner and deliver mate with your rook.
